title: Influence Bound by Average Cost
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing the real-valued version of $f$. Under the product distribution on the sign alphabet whose mean is $1-2p$, the total influence of $f$ is at most $2\sqrt{p(1-p)}$ times the square root of the average cost of $T$ under that distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ signs
$T$ is a randomized decision tree computing the real-valued sign-valued function $f$
